### Checklist

- [ ] There is an issue for this, and what it should do was agreed there (typos excepted).
- [ ] New logic has unit tests, and anything that changes what reaches the network has an
      integration test in `integration/headers.test.js`.
- [ ] A bug fix has a test that fails without it.
- [ ] No new dependency in `dependencies`. A new `devDependency` is argued for in the description.
- [ ] `version` in `package.json` is untouched. The release workflow owns it.
- [ ] `dist/` is not in the diff.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`, if a user would notice this.

### Anything a reviewer should be suspicious of

<!--
Where you are unsure, what you could not test, a trade-off you made on purpose.
This section is the most useful one in the template. Saying "nothing" is fine.
-->

### Tick if it applies

- [ ] **Touches the manifest, permissions, or Firefox's `data_collection_permissions`.** Both stores
      review these and a change can hold up a release. Say what you changed and why it is needed.
- [ ] **Touches a URL pattern, `rules.js`, or an engine.** Confirm an unusable pattern still fails
      closed rather than shipping the include rules alone, and that rule conditions still name their
      resource types explicitly — omitting them spares every top-level page load.
- [ ] **Changes a measurement in `popup.css` or `options.css`.** Say what you measured it against.
      The popup is specified to the pixel at 780px.
- [ ] **Was partly generated by an AI tool.** Disclose it with an `Assisted-by:` or `Co-Authored-By:`
      commit trailer. You are still the author and answerable for every line.
